explication: Hackney is an Erlang HTTP client. The principal workflow starts with an application calling the public request API, which obtains a connection and exchanges an HTTP request and response; callers may use synchronous bodies or asynchronous/streaming responses. The README also documents pooling, HTTP/2 negotiation, experimental HTTP/3, WebSocket and WebTransport APIs, and supporting request features. Source excerpts were unavailable, so the graph uses documented relationships only; it does not infer internal call chains.
